```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Packages needed:
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
here::i_am("Data_Processing/tidy_datas.Rmd")
library(here)
```

```{r}
cowg <- read.table(here("raw_data","Carnoules_compas 2019_2021-vérifié-2.csv"), 
                   dec=c(",","."), sep=";", na.strings = c("NA", ""))[-c(1,106:111),]
rownames(cowg) <- 1:nrow(cowg)
```


Cleaning dates format:
```{r}
dates <- cowg[1,3:101]

parse_date_time_robust <- function(x){
   parse_date_time(
     x,
     orders = c('dmy','dmY','mdy','mdY','ymd','y-md'),
     quiet=TRUE
   )
}
dates <- parse_date_time_robust(dates)
```

```{r}
COWG <- data.frame(
  "dates" = dates,
  "temperature" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[2,3:101])),
  "ph" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[3,3:101])),
  "eh" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[4,3:101])),
  "conductivity" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[5,3:101])),
  "o2" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[10,3:101])),
  "o2_hach" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[10,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "o2_colorimetrie" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "o2_mettler" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "aluminium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[34,3:101])),
  "antimony" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[66,3:101])),
  "antimony_123Sb" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "antimony_121Sb" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[66,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "asV" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[23,3:101])),
  "asIII" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[24,3:101])),
  "total_arsenic" = as.numeric(cowg[53,3:101]),
  "baryum" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[70,3:101])),
  "baryum_138Ba" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "baryum_137Ba" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[70,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "baryum_136Ba" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "bore" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[31,3:101])),
  "cadmium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[62,3:101])),
  "cadmium_114Cd" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "cadmium_111Cd" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[62,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "calcium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[37,3:101])),
  "calcium_44Ca" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[37,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "calcium_43Ca" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "caesium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[68,3:101])),
  "chromium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[41,3:101])),
  "chromium_53Cr" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "chromium_52Cr" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[41,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "cobalt" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[45,3:101])),
  "copper" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[48,3:101])),
  "copper_65Cu" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "copper_63Cu" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[48,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "total_iron" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[44,3:101])),
  "lanthanum" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[72,3:101])),
  "agnesium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[33,3:101])),
  "nickel" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[46,3:101])),
  "nickel_62Ni" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "nickel_60Ni" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[46,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "lead" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[77,3:101])),
  "lead_208Pb" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[77,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "lead_207Pb" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "lead_206Pb" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "rubidium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[55,3:101])),
  "sodium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[32,3:101])),
  "sulfur" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[35,3:101])),
  "strontium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[57,3:101])),
  "strontium_88Sr" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[57,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "strontium_86Sr" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "sulfate" = (as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[35,3:101])) * 96)/32000,
  "thallium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[74,3:101])),
  "thallium_205Tl" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[74,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "thallium_203Tl" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "titanium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[38,3:101])),
  "titanium_49Ti" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "titanium_47Ti" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[38,3:101]))), 0,1),
  "vanadium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[40,3:101])),
  "yttrium" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[58,3:101])),
  "zinc" = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[50,3:101])),
  "zinc_68Zn" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "zinc_67Zn" = rep(0, 101-2),
  "zinc_66Zn" = ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", cowg[50,3:101]))), 0,1)
  )
```

```{r}
COWG$dates <- as.Date(format(COWG$dates, "%Y-%m-01"))
```

```{r}
mean_COWG <- COWG %>%
  group_by(dates) %>%
  summarise(temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm=T),
            ph = mean(ph, na.rm=T),
            eh = mean(eh, na.rm=T),
            conductivity = mean(conductivity, na.rm=T),
            o2 = mean(o2, na.rm=T),
            o2_hach = max(o2_hach, na.rm=T),
            o2_colorimetrie = max(o2_colorimetrie, na.rm=T),
            o2_mettler = max(o2_mettler, na.rm=T),
            aluminium = mean(aluminium, na.rm=T),
            antimony = mean(antimony, na.rm=T),
            antimony_123Sb = max(antimony_123Sb, na.rm=T),
            antimony_121Sb = max(antimony_121Sb, na.rm=T),
            asV = mean(asV, na.rm=T),
            asIII = mean(asIII, na.rm=T),
            total_arsenic = mean(total_arsenic, na.rm=T),
            baryum = mean(baryum, na.rm=T),
            baryum_138Ba = max(baryum_138Ba, na.rm=T),
            baryum_137Ba = max(baryum_137Ba, na.rm=T),
            baryum_136Ba = max(baryum_136Ba, na.rm=T),
            bore = mean(bore, na.rm=T),
            cadmium = mean(cadmium, na.rm=T),
            cadmium_114Cd = max(cadmium_114Cd, na.rm=T),
            cadmium_111Cd = max(cadmium_111Cd, na.rm=T),
            calcium = mean(calcium, na.rm=T),
            calcium_44Ca = max(calcium_44Ca, na.rm=T),
            calcium_43Ca = max(calcium_43Ca, na.rm=T),
            caesium = mean(caesium, na.rm=T),
            chromium = mean(chromium, na.rm=T),
            chromium_53Cr = max(chromium_53Cr, na.rm=T),
            chromium_52Cr = max(chromium_52Cr, na.rm=T),
            cobalt = mean(cobalt, na.rm=T),
            copper = mean(copper, na.rm=T),
            copper_65Cu = max(copper_65Cu, na.rm=T),
            copper_63Cu = max(copper_63Cu, na.rm=T),
            total_iron = mean(total_iron, na.rm=T),
            lanthanum = mean(lanthanum, na.rm=T),
            magnesium = mean(magnesium, na.rm=T),
            nickel = mean(nickel, na.rm=T),
            nickel_62Ni = max(nickel_62Ni, na.rm=T),
            nickel_60Ni = max(nickel_60Ni, na.rm=T),
            lead = mean(lead, na.rm=T),
            lead_208Pb = max(lead_208Pb, na.rm=T),
            lead_207Pb = max(lead_207Pb, na.rm=T),
            lead_206Pb = max(lead_206Pb, na.rm=T),
            rubidium = mean(rubidium, na.rm=T),
            sodium = mean(sodium, na.rm=T),
            sulfur = mean(sulfur, na.rm=T),
            strontium = mean(strontium, na.rm=T),
            strontium_88Sr = max(strontium_88Sr, na.rm=T),
            strontium_86Sr = max(strontium_86Sr, na.rm=T),
            thallium = mean(thallium, na.rm=T),
            thallium_205Tl = max(thallium_205Tl, na.rm=T),
            thallium_203Tl = max(thallium_203Tl, na.rm=T),
            titanium = mean(titanium, na.rm=T),
            titanium_49Ti = max(titanium_49Ti, na.rm=T),
            titanium_47Ti = max(titanium_47Ti, na.rm=T),

```

```{r}
mean_COWG <- sapply(mean_COWG, function(x) { x[is.nan(x)] <- NA; x })
```

```{r}
write_delim(as.data.frame(mean_COWG), here("processed","recent_COWG.csv"), delim = ";")
```
